# Fonts: 57 font families

Use `fontFamily` exactly as written (case and spaces matter); pick a `fontWeight` from the list in parentheses, other weights are substituted. Any other family fails validation. After the colon: the scripts the family covers; other scripts fall back to the matching Noto family (Han to Noto Sans SC unless a JP/TC/KR family is chosen).
